rationale: The 'fresh' recovery policy was chosen over snapshot rollback or guest repair for Step 7 artifact verification failures because when an in-guest artifact fails cryptographic checksum validation or exhibits corrupt state, the integrity of the entire guest runtime is suspect. Attempting in-place repairs risks compounding silent defects. By terminating and purging the compromised guest and booting a fresh sandbox from an immutable base template, the agent guarantees deterministic reproduction, clean memory state, zero residual state pollution, and strict audit compliance.
